test_title: PYST 61: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

This is the garage __when__ I get my car repaired.
solution:
The correct answer is "**where**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that substitutes when is '**where**.'
 
• '**When**' is used as a relative pronoun in the relative section.
 
 
• **Example**: ***When** are you coming to Nanded?*
 
 
 
• **Where** is used as a conjunction denoting "in that location" or "in those circumstances"
 
 
• **Example**: ***Where** is my book?*
 
 

**The correct sentence is:** *This is the garage **where** I get my car repaired.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us understand when to use other words.
 
• '**whenever**' is used to refer to a time and situation that happens. 
 
 
• **Example**: ***Whenever** dad comes home, he always brings chocolate. *
 
 
 
• '**wherever**' is used to join two clauses. 
 
 
• **Example**: ***Wherever** I go, I stuck in traffic. *
